title: Rav Chinena son of Rav Yehoshua
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Pesachim 110b (Hyman cites 110a)](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.110b.9), saying that asparagus [drink] combines [with the cups] for good. Hyman reports the Dikdukei Soferim reading as Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Pesachim has Rav Chinena son of Rabbi Yehoshua. Hyman’s heading gives Rav before Yehoshua.
The linked passage says the asparagus drink counts for good and not for harm. Hyman abbreviates the statement and reports Huna instead of Chinena from Dikdukei Soferim.
